params.name: from
params.description: Start of a time range supplied in dateOption parameter. Format must be compliant with ISO8601 and expressed in UTC format. Maximum precision is down to the second. (Example: 2021-03-16T16:19:58).

params.name: to
params.description: End of a time range supplied in dateOption parameter. Format must be compliant with ISO8601 and expressed in UTC format. Maximum precision is down to the second. (Example: 2021-03-16T16:19:58).

params.name: dateOption
params.description: Date range option (lastUpdatedDate, recordDate). By default service will return the latest events.

params.name: groupId
params.description: Id of the group of the events of interest. If the group does not exist or is not visible to the user due to security then no results will be returned. If not supplied, then events in all groups accessible to the group of encompassed access key will be returned (GUID).

params.name: triggers
params.description: Ids of triggers of events to be filtered.

params.name: statuses
params.description: Ids of statuses of events to be filtered.

params.name: behaviors
params.description: Ids of behaviors of events to be filtered.

params.name: driverId
params.description: Id of a driver associated to the event (GUID).

params.name: vehicleId
params.description: Id of a vehicle associated to the event (GUID).

params.name: deviceId
params.description: Id of a device associated to the event.

params.name: sortDirection
params.description: Type of sorting direction (asc or desc). By default the service will return items in descending order.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: A value to sort by (lastUpdatedDate, recordDate). By deafult the service will return items sorted by last updated date.

params.name: includeSubgroups
params.description: Indicates whether results should include data for all subgroups of the group specified. Default to true.

params.name: limit
params.description: Indicates count of items to retrieve. By default the service will return 1000 items. Range: [1, 1000]

params.name: page
params.description:
Number of the page of event records to be returned.
            If not provided, first page of records will be returned.
